column1: review_text
Excellent battery life and the active noise cancellation works beautifully on my daily train commute. Worth the price.
Stopped charging after exactly 33 days. Just missed the return window. Completely dead, do not buy!!
sound quality is crisp but the ear cups are a bit tight if you wear glasses. still keeping it though.
The mic quality is garbage. Everyone on my Zoom calls says I sound like I am underwater.
Blown away by the bass response. Connects instantly to both my iPhone and laptop without manual switching.
It's just okay. Nothing special for the money. The plastic frame feels a bit flimsy.
Disappointed. Constant Bluetooth dropping issues. Had to restart my phone multiple times to sync.
Best purchase of the year. Battery lasts almost a whole week of moderate use.
Good headphones overall but the charging cable included in the box is ridiculously short.
Too heavy on the head. Gives me a headache after an hour of gaming.
Fits perfectly! The material is thick, breathable, and doesn't shrink in the washer. Will order more colors.
Sizing is completely off. Ordered a Large but it fits like a Small. Material feels rough and cheap.
Nice hoodie. Very soft inside. Lost one star because the zipper gets stuck occasionally.
Color doesn't look like the photo online. It's more of a dull gray than navy blue.
Super comfortable for working out. Sweat-wicking works as advertised.
Stitching started coming apart at the seams after the first wash. Poor quality control.
A bit baggy but very warm. Great for lounging around the house.
Arrived with a weird chemical smell that didn't go away even after washing it twice.
Excellent quality for the price point. Highly recommend checking the size chart before buying.
Decent shirt but shrinks significantly if you accidentally put it in the dryer.
This blender is a beast. Crushes ice into snow in seconds. Smoothies come out perfectly consistent.
Leaked from the bottom container on the very first use. Made a massive mess on my counter.
Great coffee maker, brews super fast. Wish the water reservoir was slightly larger.
Extremely loud. Sounds like a lawnmower is running in my kitchen every morning.
Easy to clean, compact design, and looks sleek on the counter. Very satisfied.
Works fine for basic things but struggles with frozen fruits or tougher vegetables.
The heating element burnt out after two months. Customer service refused to replace it.
Saves so much time cooking dinner. Non-stick coating seems durable so far.
Absolute game changer for meal prep. Don't know how I lived without it.
Instruction manual is poorly translated and impossible to follow. Had to look up YouTube tutorials.
My skin has never looked better. Hydrating without feeling greasy or causing breakouts.
Broke me out in hives within 24 hours. Beware if you have sensitive skin.
Smells amazing and leaves hair soft, but the pump bottle mechanism arrived broken.
Average product. Didn't notice any dramatic change after using the entire bottle.
A little goes a long way. This bottle will easily last me six months.
Way too drying for my skin type. Made my foundation look patchy.
Good value for money. Texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly.
Fake product! Packaging looks completely different from the one I bought at Sephora.
Highly recommend! Cleared up my dark spots in less than three weeks.
The scent is overpowering. If you are sensitive to strong perfumes, skip this.
Keeps water ice cold even after sitting in a hot car for 8 hours. Best flask ever.
The zipper on the backpack ripped completely open during my first hike. Not heavy duty at all.
Very lightweight and easy to fold up. Great additions to our camping gear setup.
The resistance bands snapped after a week of standard use. Dangerous design.
Excellent grip on wet trails. No slipping or blisters after a 10-mile break-in run.
Good mat but it stretches out a bit during hot yoga sessions.
Missing half the parts in the box. Couldn't even assemble the net.
Solid basketball for outdoor courts. Holds air pressure well over time.
Tracking accuracy on this watch is spot on compared to my older premium devices.
The fabric is thin and feels like it will rip if it catches on any branch.
The display is gorgeous. Refresh rate makes scrolling incredibly fluid and responsive.
Screen flickering issue out of the box. Returning this immediately.
Decent laptop for students. Lightweight, good trackpad, but speakers are quiet.
Gets incredibly hot while playing basic indie games. Fan sounds like a jet engine.
Unbelievable value. Performance rivals tablets that cost twice as much.
The user interface is laggy and full of pre-installed bloatware apps you can't delete.
Fast charging works great. Goes from 0 to 80% in about 35 minutes.
Do not buy refurbished from here. Scratches all over the screen and battery health is at 60%.
Setup took less than 2 minutes. Strong mesh Wi-Fi signal across my entire house now.
The remote control requires exact line of sight or it won't register inputs.
These jeans have the perfect amount of stretch. Comfortable all day long.
The color bled all over my other clothes in the laundry despite washing with cold water.
Warm winter coat. Plenty of pockets. It runs slightly larger than standard sizing.
The material is incredibly sheer. You can see right through it in sunlight.
Classic design, well made, and fits true to size. Will buy from this brand again.
Socks are fine but elastic around the ankle is loose and they slide down.
Button fell off within ten minutes of wearing it for the first time. Terrible stitching.
Great summer dress. Lightweight and breathable. Needs an iron out of the package.
Feels like premium designer quality without the insane luxury price markup.
Shrunk two whole sizes after one gentle cycle wash. Hand wash only I guess.
Super sharp knives. Cut through raw meat like butter. Handle balance feels great.
The nonstick pan started peeling off flecks into our food after three weeks.
Air fryer works incredibly well. Crispy fries without the oil. Basket cleaning is easy.
Toasts unevenly. One side of the bread is burnt while the other is barely warm.
Organized my entire pantry with these containers. Airtight seal keeps cereal fresh.
The vacuum cleaner suction dropped significantly after cleaning up a small patch of pet hair.
Good basic microwave. Controls are intuitive. A bit louder than my previous one.
The glass pitcher shattered when pouring warm tea. Absolute safety hazard.
Saves so much space in my tiny kitchen. Foldable design is genius.
It gets the job done but the power cord is too short to reach my island outlet.
This lip balm is the only thing that saves my dry chapped lips during winter.
Gave me a massive rash. Check the ingredient list carefully before purchasing.
Matte finish stays on all day without smudging, but it's hard to remove at night.
The product arrived completely dried out and unusable. Seemed like old stock.
Waterproof formula actually holds up during swimming and heavy gym sessions.
Decent coverage but the shade range is very limited. Hard to match neutral undertones.
Leaves hair looking shiny and bouncy without weighing it down. Subtle clean scent.
Extremely greasy formula. Left my skin looking like an oil slick and clogged my pores.
Perfect dupe for the expensive high-end department store serums. Don't overpay.
The dropper bottle leaks from the top cap if it tips over in your makeup bag.
Very stable kayak even in windy lake conditions. Easy to inflate and pack away.
The pedal fell completely off the bike crank arm while riding. Threading was stripped.
Excellent yoga blocks. Dense foam provides reliable support without compressing.
